patches.name: Patch 28 — GRID Runtime Engine
patches.summary: GRID transitions from static structured space to active runtime simulation engine. NODE = stateful actor with tick_fn. Tick loop: ingest→route(ODIN)→validate(AEGIS)→execute(SKADI)→reconcile(MNEMOS)→drift(HUGINN)→log.
patches.notes: gridTick() with full field propagation + NODE_TICK_FNS for all 27 God Systems. KRONOS modes: real(900ms auto)/stepped(manual)/replay(scrub tickHistory)/frozen. tickHistory ring buffer (60 ticks) for REPLAY. GOVERNOR object: JARVIS injects load intentions for N ticks above GRID layer. Pipeline pulse animation in L6: active stage highlighted white each tick. Left/right in TRON replay mode scrubs tick history. GL7 compliant — no new systems.

patches.name: Patch 29 — GNPL Consensus Engine
patches.summary: Multi-agent graph agreement + conflict resolution for Claude/Codex/GPT/Gemini/Mythos operating on shared GRID state.
patches.notes: GNPL object: 4-agent registry (jarvis/codex/gpt/gemini) with authority scores. Proposal lifecycle: propose→vote→commit|reject|conflict. ZEUS arbitrates conflicts by authority score. GOVERNOR.intent() called on commit for load application. speakSend() routes AYRE+APOLLO+MNEMOS through GNPL.propose('jarvis',...) instead of direct GRID.set(). L6 pipeline view shows active proposals + recent history. BUS events: gnpl_propose/gnpl_commit/gnpl_reject/gnpl_conflict. GL7: replaces ad-hoc GRID.set() calls in SPEAK with governed proposal layer.

patches.name: Patch 33 — MNEMOS Vector Layer
patches.summary: Semantic memory search via pgvector. Replace ILIKE keyword search with cosine similarity. Embedding API integration (cloud-first, no local deps). Options: Supabase pgvector + Voyage AI / jina-embeddings / OpenAI text-embedding-3-small. mnemos-embed edge function stores vector on memory insert. mnemos-search edge function does similarity query.
patches.notes: Depends on MNEMOS cloud layer (done). GL7: pgvector extension already available in Supabase — no new infrastructure. Removes ILIKE limitation; enables 'find memories about Aincrad' even if stored text says SAO. Requires choosing an embedding API provider and storing EMBEDDING_API_KEY in Supabase secrets.
